title: Capstone
description: Complete a defensive SOC shift from synthetic alert triage through case investigations, detection review and a documented change of watch.

lessons.title: Capstone: triage alerts 1-15
lessons.summary: Build a first-pass triage queue for the first 15 synthetic alerts and document priorities.
objectives: Read the case inputs and source fields
Prioritise alerts using impact and confidence
Record evidence and the next owned decision

lessons.title: Capstone: triage alerts 16-30
lessons.summary: Complete triage for alerts 16?30 and reconcile the queue with the first batch.
objectives: Group duplicate items while preserving auditability
Record evidence gaps and independent leads
Hand off the complete queue with priorities

lessons.title: Capstone: case 1
lessons.summary: Investigate the first capstone case and separate evidence of execution from unverified scope.
objectives: Construct a sourced chronology
Explain confirmed scope and remaining gaps
Propose and verify a simulated response

lessons.title: Capstone: case 2
lessons.summary: Investigate the second capstone case using authentication evidence and identity context.
objectives: Interpret failed and successful authentication events
Distinguish identity findings from device attribution
Define an actionable risk handoff

lessons.title: Capstone: case 3
lessons.summary: Investigate the third capstone case and decide whether verified benign context resolves the alert.
objectives: Test the benign hypothesis with independent records
Document the threshold for reopening
Separate closure from permanent suppression

lessons.title: Capstone: detection 1
lessons.summary: Specify and test a defensive detection from the capstone evidence using offline fixtures.
objectives: State a relationship, window and grouping field
Exercise positive and negative fixture cases
Bound the coverage and downstream response

lessons.title: Capstone: detection 2
lessons.summary: Review a second capstone detection for context, duplicates and gaps.
objectives: Define expected signals and important false positives
Verify behaviour with controlled fixtures
Recommend tuning and review criteria

lessons.title: Capstone: shift report
lessons.summary: Write a shift report with decisions, evidence, operational risks and clear ownership.
objectives: Reconcile all capstone alert dispositions
Communicate actionable findings with confidence
Assign verification and next review to named roles
